name: Delicious Chicken Kitezhgrad
desc: A breaded chicken dish fried to golden perfection. The moment your knife breaks through the crisp crust, melted butter wells out like thawing snow and winds across the plate in a tiny golden stream. Together with the melt-in-your-mouth chicken, it creates a rich and harmonious symphony of flavor.

value.text: Increases all party members' Physical DMG by 40% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
